ApproachHint.wits: Talk, plan aloud, use tools and machines, read. Human form only.

jaguar.name: Jaguar
jaguar.text: In Dark places, your Sneak rolls are at −1 Difficulty.

snowleopard.name: Snow Leopard
snowleopard.text: Your first Strike in each Clash is at −1 Difficulty.

cheetah.name: Cheetah
cheetah.text: Once per scene, Push a Move roll without spending Wild.

coyote.name: Coyote
coyote.text: Once per scene, Help without spending Wild.

dog.name: Shepherd Dog
dog.text: In Crowds, your Sneak and Sense rolls are at −1 Difficulty.

fox.name: Red Fox
fox.text: Once per scene, when your roll Fails, it becomes a Partial instead.

falcon.name: Peregrine Falcon
falcon.text: In Open or High places, your Sense rolls are at −1 Difficulty.

owl.name: Barn Owl
owl.text: In Dark places, +1 die on Sneak and Move rolls.

raven.name: Raven
raven.text: Against Locked things you can roll Wits in animal form (rating 2) to work latches, keys and switches.

mouse.name: House Mouse
mouse.text: In Narrow places, your Sneak and Move rolls are at −1 Difficulty.

rat.name: Brown Rat
rat.text: Against Locked things, your Force rating is 3.

squirrel.name: Grey Squirrel
squirrel.text: In High places, your Move rolls are at −1 Difficulty.

bison.name: Bison
bison.text: Once per scene, when you'd take Hurt, take 1 less.

moose.name: Moose
moose.text: Once per scene, when your Strike against a Beater or Hound Succeeds, it's out at once.

hippo.name: Hippopotamus
hippo.text: Once per scene, when a Force roll Succeeds, it counts as a Critical.

gator.name: Alligator
gator.text: In Water, your Sneak and Force rolls are at −1 Difficulty.

python.name: Python
python.text: When your Strike Succeeds, the next roll anyone makes against that threat this Clash is at −1 Difficulty.

komodo.name: Komodo Dragon
komodo.text: +1 die on Sense rolls, and a Hound's Tracker doesn't affect you.

gamer.name: Gamer
gamer.text: Start every mission with 1 extra Wild.

captain.name: Team Captain
captain.text: The team starts every mission with 1 Edge.

whisperer.name: Animal Whisperer
whisperer.text: +1 die on rolls against Hounds, or to get past an obstacle they guard.

gymnast.name: Gymnast
gymnast.text: +1 die on rolls in High places.

nightowl.name: Night Owl
nightowl.text: +1 die on rolls in Dark places.

hound.name: Hound
hound.special: Sneak rolls at an obstacle a Hound guards are at +1 Difficulty.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.special: When you Fail against a Trapper, you're Netted instead of Hurt.

huntsman.name: Huntsman
huntsman.special: Sneak rolls at an obstacle a Huntsman guards are at +1 Difficulty.

master.name: Master of the Hunt
master.special: Only when the Hunt is Up. Masters are never fought. While they're here, any Fail means you're Taken.

StatusHint.down: 3 Hurt: you can't act until the scene ends. Then you're back up with 2 Hurt if a friend is standing and the Hunt isn't Up; otherwise Taken.
StatusHint.netted: You can't act until a friend frees you (their action, no roll). Freed at scene end if a friend is standing and the Hunt isn't Up; otherwise Taken.
StatusHint.taken: Caged by the Hunt: out for the mission. If you carried the prize, it's lost.
StatusHint.exposed: The Hunt knows your face and your Mark: the next mission starts at Scent 1.
StatusHint.stuck: You went Down in animal form: you can't shift back until the mission ends.

GrowthHint.wild: Start every mission with 1 more Wild, to a maximum of 6 (counting Gamer).
GrowthHint.rating: +1 to a human rating, to a maximum of 3 (a different rating each time).
GrowthHint.wildsense: One of your frame's Strengths also works in human form.

ClashHint.distract: Sneak or Move. A Success puts the next Strike against it this round at −1 Difficulty.
ClashHint.slip: Move or Sneak. A Success takes you out of the Clash, and you go on.

autoProgress.name: Apply roll outcomes: progress
autoProgress.hint: The GM's client applies each roll at the current obstacle or Clash: progress, who's past, Edges from Criticals, harm to threats, Distract and Slip Away. Off: the Storyteller applies each outcome with one click.

autoScent.name: Apply Scent automatically
autoScent.hint: Every rise the rules call for (Partials and Fails, group obstacles ending, long rounds, Clashes ending, seen shifts, scouting, Exposed). Off: each rise is suggested on the tracker.

autoHurt.name: Apply Hurt and Netted
autoHurt.hint: Hurt from dangerous obstacles and from threats' Harm (with Shaggy Coat), Netted from a Trapper on a Fail, Down at 3 Hurt.

autoClash.name: Start Clashes on a guarded Fail
autoClash.hint: A Fail at a guarded obstacle starts a Clash with its guards (as tokens when there is a scene, otherwise on the tracker).

autoTaken.name: Apply Taken and scene ends
autoTaken.hint: Any Fail once the Hunt is Up means Taken; Down and Netted friends get up or are Taken when the scene ends; everyone down at once is Taken.

autoWild.name: Spend Wild automatically
autoWild.hint: Shifting, Pushing, Helping and Patching Up take the Wild (or the Hurt) by themselves. Off: costs are shown as reminders only.

autoGrowth.name: Mark Growth after a mission
autoGrowth.hint: When the Storyteller finishes a mission, every character in it marks 1 Growth.

threatTargets.name: Unattended threats choose
threatTargets.hint: At the end of a Clash round each threat nobody rolled against hurts one character: ask the Storyteller (a random friend is preselected), or pick at random.

trackerForPlayers.name: Players see the Mission Tracker
trackerForPlayers.hint: Players get a read-only tracker with Roll buttons for the current obstacle.

trackerAutoOpen.name: Open the tracker when a mission is running
trackerAutoOpen.hint: Opens the Mission Tracker when you log in during a mission.

rulesReminders.name: Rules reminders in chat
rulesReminders.hint: Short reminders on cards: shifting takes your action, Push before the next roll, how a Clash raises Scent.

Reason.notGM: Only the Storyteller can do that.
Reason.timeout: The Storyteller didn't answer in time.
Reason.down: Down: you can't act until the scene ends.
Reason.netted: Netted: a friend has to free you first.
Reason.stuck: Stuck: you can't shift back until the mission ends.
Reason.shiftWouldDown: No Wild, and taking 1 Hurt instead would put you Down.
Reason.cantPush: This roll can't be Pushed now.
Reason.badHelp: At most two friends can usefully Help a roll.
Reason.noEdges: The team has no Edges left.
Reason.animalWits: Animals can't roll or help Wits (the Raven can, against Locked things).
Reason.zeroRating: A rating of 0 means you can't roll that approach.
Reason.actionApproach: That Clash action uses other approaches.
Reason.cantAct: Down, Netted or Taken: can't act.
Reason.noPickLeft: No Growth pick left (one at 2, 4 and 6 Growth).
Reason.pickTaken: You can't choose the same thing twice.
Reason.ratingTaken: That rating has already had its +1.
Reason.noStrength: Choose one of your frame's Strengths.

Problem.frameMismatch: The frame doesn't match the animal.
Problem.samePerk: The second perk is the same as the first.
Problem.perk2WithoutPick: A second perk needs its Growth pick.
Problem.ratings: Human ratings must be 3, 2, 2, 1 and 1 in some order (plus any +1 from Growth).
Problem.tooManyPicks: More Growth picks than Growth allows.
Problem.wildSenseTag: Wild Sense must be one of your frame's Strengths.
Problem.duplicateAnimal: Another Bonded already has the {animal}: no two in a group have the same animal.

Notify.noGM: The Storyteller isn't connected: nothing was changed.
Notify.noCharacter: You have no Bonded to roll for.
Notify.gmOnly: Only the Storyteller can do that.
Notify.noParty: Choose at least one Bonded for the mission.
Notify.trackerHidden: The Storyteller keeps the Mission Tracker to themselves.

Notice.downStuck: {name} is Down, and Stuck in animal form until the mission ends.
Notice.freedSceneEnd: {name} wriggles free as the scene ends.
Notice.clashReminder: Each round everyone takes one action. Every threat nobody rolls against hurts someone. It ends when every threat is out, nobody is left, or after round 4: Scent +1, or +2 if it reaches round 4, someone goes Down or someone shifts.
Notice.missionStart: {name}: the mission begins. Scent Limit {limit}, Edges {edges}.
Notice.exposedStart: Someone was Exposed last time: the Hunt is watching, and Scent starts at 1.

resultHint.win: The objective is done and nobody was Taken.
resultHint.costly: The objective is done, but someone was Taken. The Hunt track rises by 1.
resultHint.loss: The objective isn't done. The Hunt track rises by 2.

into.hurt: {name} shifts into the {animal} with no Wild left (1 Hurt).
into.manual: {name} shifts into the {animal} (pay 1 Wild, or 1 Hurt).

Shift.inClash: In a Clash every shift is in sight: Exposed, and the Clash will raise Scent by 2.
Shift.watched: The Hunt is watching: Scent +1, and Exposed.
Shift.prizeDrops: The prize drops at their feet.
Shift.reminder: Shifting takes your action (it's free on the way between obstacles).

Roll.pushedBurst: Burst: {n} dice rerolled, no Wild spent.
Roll.wily: Wily: the Fail becomes a Partial.
Roll.charge: Charge: the Success counts as a Critical.
Roll.sweep: Antler Sweep: it's out at once.
Roll.unpaid: Help counted: each helper pays 1 Wild.
Roll.pendingHint: Push or accept before the next roll.

scout.crit: The team picks the way in and gains two Edges.
scout.success: The team picks the way in and gains an Edge.
scout.partial: The team picks the way in, but Scent starts at 1.
scout.fail: The Storyteller picks the way in, and Scent starts at 1.

group.crit: Past it, and the team gains an Edge.
group.fail: Not past yet; Scent rises when the obstacle ends.

Outcome.escapeFree: (In the Escape a Partial costs no Scent.)
Outcome.taken: The Hunt is Up: a Fail means Taken.

distract.success: {name} is Distracted: the next Strike on it this round is at −1 Difficulty.

slip.success: Out of the Clash, and past the obstacle.
slip.partial: Out of the Clash, and past the obstacle.

RollDialog.title: Roll: {name}
RollDialog.notListed: That approach isn't listed for this obstacle: pick the nearest one, or let the Storyteller set the Difficulty.
RollDialog.overCap: Some Help or Edges are over the Cap: they aren't spent.
RollDialog.alreadyPast: You're already past this obstacle: this roll won't count for it (you can still Help friends).
RollDialog.odds: At least a Partial {partial} · Success {success} · Critical {crit}
RollDialog.trail: On the Trail: this Escape obstacle is at +1 Difficulty.

Sheet.name: Name

shiftCost.none: Free, but it takes your action. Stuck: no.
shiftCost.hurt: No Wild: 1 Hurt instead, and your action.

Sheet.wildSenseLine: Wild Sense: your {tag} Strength works in human form too.

Builder.title: Character builder: {name}
Builder.intro: Choose a frame and an animal, place your human ratings and pick a human perk, or roll it all by the book. No two Bonded in a group have the same animal.
Builder.ratings: Human ratings: put {spread} into the five approaches

Tracker.title: Mission Tracker
Tracker.customHint: Your mission as data: two ways in, the obstacles inside, the objective and the Escape. Each obstacle has a name, a kind (point or group), tags, approaches with their Difficulty, the progress a point obstacle needs, guards (beater, hound, trapper, huntsman), guardsClear, dangerous, and carry for a prize. Give a Limit for 3, 4 and 5 players (Chapter 12 explains how to set them).
Tracker.huntUp: The Hunt is Up! The Masters are coming. Any Fail now means Taken.
Tracker.choice: The objective isn't done: press on, or Withdraw to the Escape (a Loss)?

suggest.press: The book's advice: press on, you're already working on the objective.

Tracker.scoutPrompt: One of you rolls Sense against Difficulty {d}.

picks.team: The team picks the way in.
picks.storyteller: The Storyteller picks the way in.

Tracker.trailHere: On the Trail: +1 Difficulty for every approach here.
Tracker.roundCost: every round from now on costs Scent +1
Tracker.targetsTitle: Who do the threats go for?
Tracker.targetsHint: Each threat nobody rolled against this round deals its Harm to one character. Pick whoever it would really go for.
Tracker.prizeDropped: dropped: someone has to pick it up
Tracker.endMissionConfirm: End the mission now and work out its result?
Tracker.lastHunt: The Hunt track is at 6: the next mission is the Last Hunt.

Cause.longRound: another round with someone not past

Log.clashDue: A Fail at {name}: the guards turn. Finish this round's rolls, then End Round starts the Clash.
Log.edgeLost: An Edge from {why} is lost: the team holds at most 2.
Log.captain: Team Captain: the team starts with {edges} Edge(s).
Log.trail: On the Trail: {name} is at +1 Difficulty.
Log.withdraw: The team Withdraws to the Escape.
Log.clashEnd: The Clash ends after {rounds} round(s): Scent +{rise}.
Log.stillProgress: The guards are gone, but {name} still needs progress.
Log.shiftSeen: {who} shifts in sight of the Hunt: Exposed.
Log.allOut: Everyone is down at once: everyone is Taken.
Log.finished: {result}: the Hunt track goes from {from} to {to}.
Log.lastHunt: The Hunt track reaches 6: the Last Hunt comes early.
Log.manualScent: The Storyteller sets Scent from {from} to {to}.
